articles.title: Harry Kane wins a trophy with Bayern, Anthony Gordon makes his Barcelona debut plus lots more in the Euro Debrief
articles.summary: A trophy for Harry Kane with Bayern Munich and two assists for Anthony Gordon on his Barcelona debut; Adam Bate picks out the big stories from the continent in the Euro Debrief, a Sky Sports column focusing on the major European leagues and more
articles.body:
Welcome to The Euro Debrief , a new Sky Sports column in which Adam Bate rounds up some of the key stories from the latest matches across the continent. This week:

Amorim's Milan win but Inter look strong

Being in Dortmund for the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup, the expectation was that Harry Kane would add to the 73 goals that he scored last season for Bayern Munich. Instead, the opener in their 2-1 win at Borussia Dortmund was scored by Nathaniel Brown.

The summer signing from Eintracht Frankfurt is better known as a left-back but was preferred in the No 10 role to fellow new arrival Ismael Saibari and responded by whipping the ball low into the corner inside the first half. He could have had more too.

Brown, 23, fired just wide of the far post after getting away down the left channel in the 43rd minute and drew roars from the away end when he charged forward just after the hour. He then sprang another attack with a smart turn that led to Kane firing just over.

Speaking to Kane afterwards, he praised his new partner. "It was a great performance. Not his natural position but he has had spells there in pre-season. He is obviously a smart player, really good on the ball, good in tight areas, and you saw that with his finish."

Kane described Brown as "a very versatile player" and pointed out that he had already scored in pre-season. But some adjustments will be required. Brown barely touched the ball prior to his 28th-minute goal, often being missed out of their passing sequences.

Vincent Kompany will have to be patient with Jamal Musiala following his unfortunate health scare, twice collapsing on the pitch. Saibari will be able to help with that. But the creative use of Brown could prove useful when the Bundesliga kicks off next weekend.

LaLiga: Mourinho wins late, Gordon's impact

The big two in Spain both won away as their LaLiga campaigns began, but the victories could hardly have been more different. While Barcelona battered Elche 5-0 - Anthony Gordon getting two assists on debut - Real Madrid needed a 90th-minute winner at Espanyol.

The identity of the scorer delighted Jose Mourinho, beginning his second spell in charge at Madrid. Carlos Espi latched onto a loose ball inside the Espanyol area to win the game 2-1 and was rewarded with a big hug from Mourinho - his 'neighbour' in Madrid.

Player and coach are both living at the club's training ground, having breakfast together every day. Those morning meetings just got a little easier for the 6'4" striker signed from Levante. He is not the highest profile player at Madrid but he could be a key weapon.

Thibaut Courtois has already described Espi as "Joselu Junior" - a reference to the former striker who scored so many crucial goals for the club, including two famous ones late on against Bayern Munich on the way to winning the Champions League for Madrid in 2024.

Espi, 21, brings something different and could be a potential game-changer under Mourinho who has always been fond of a robust centre-forward. The contrast with Barcelona could hardly be more stark where it is the mobile Raphinha is playing the role for now.

The Brazilian scored twice against Elche as Hansi Flick's embarrassment of riches in the wide areas was made clear. Lamine Yamal was quiet but that was no problem as Karim Adeyemi got a goal on his debut and Gordon came off the bench to set up a couple.

Having been at St Andrew's to see Hamza Abdelkarim impress against Birmingham in pre-season, do not rule out him playing the Espi role for Barca. Maybe they don't need Julian Alvarez anyway. He was booed by Atletico Madrid fans in their 2-2 draw with Villarreal.

LaLiga results: Real Betis 1-0 Real Sociedad, Athletic Club 1-3 Sevilla, Valencia 0-0 Celta Vigo, Espanyol 1-2 Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid 2-2 Villarreal, Getafe 1-0 Racing Santander, Elche 0-5 Barcelona.

Serie A: Amorim starts with win, Inter impress

Ruben Amorim made a winning start to life at AC Milan as they beat Torino 2-1 away from home as Serie A got under way in Italy. Scotland striker Che Adams scored an imaginative volley but it was not enough to deny Amorim's encouragingly organised side.

Juventus and Napoli also got good away wins, Kevin De Bruyne scoring late on for the latter. Maurizio Sarri made a positive start at Atalanta with a win over Sassuolo as well. However, it will be difficult for any of these clubs to dethrone champions Inter.

The double winners made a particularly strong start to their title defence with a 4-1 win over Monza. Hakan Calhanoglu's eye-catching opener was spectacular. Pio Esposito's backheeled finish for the third was even better. Both goals were set up by Andy Diouf.

Inter have spent much of the summer searching for a new right wing-back having lost Denzel Dumfries to Real Madrid. It is a position that is so important to the team under Cristian Chivu and England's Djed Spence is expected to take on the role in the long term.

But Diouf, a midfielder playing out of position there, was magnificent. It underlines the depth that Chivu has at his disposal, further emphasised by John Stones coming off the bench for Manuel Akanji as Spence and Curtis Jones looked on from the stands.

Serie A results: Inter 4-1 Monza, Udinese 1-1 Como, Genoa 0-2 Napoli, Parma 0-1 Cagliari, Frosinone 0-1 Juventus, Venezia 0-2 Lecce, Atalanta 2-1 Sassuolo, Torino 1-2 AC Milan.

Ligue 1: Slow start for PSG, drama at Marseille

Paris Saint-Germain's uncertain start to the season continued as they dropped points at Rennes, needing two goals from World Cup hero Ferran Torres to salvage a 2-2 draw in a game moved from Paris because of the poor condition of the Parc des Princes pitch.

Having been in Salzburg to see PSG scrape past a weakened Aston Villa in the UEFA Super Cup, and then follow that up with defeat to Lens in the Trophee des Champions - despite Lens being down to 10 men for the whole second half - this was not a big shock.

It will be interesting to see how Luis Enrique manages the players' minutes again this season. Will he do anything as drastic as Paulo Fonseca did for Lyon's game against Toulouse, though? The Portuguese coach changed all 11 of his line-up - and won 2-0.

It was a strategic decision by Fonseca with Lyon in the middle of a two-legged Champions League play-off with Fenerbahce that will have a huge impact on the club's finances. Beat the Turkish side in midweek and it could prove to be a masterstroke.

But the standout performance in France came from Marseille as they won 4-0 against Strasbourg. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg has been stripped of the captaincy but responded by scoring the final goal, the celebrations reflecting his popularity within the squad.

Hojbjerg turned down a transfer, much to the frustration of Marseille's ownership who are desperate to get his wages off the books with no Champions League football. "It is not a decision I agree with," said head coach Bruno Genesio of the captaincy call.

It was interesting that Genesio went public with that. He is in an awkward spot but distancing himself from his bosses looks like the smart play - for now - given this show of unity by the players. Unfortunately, Marseille could lose a number of them very soon.

Ligue 1 results: Marseille 4-0 Strasbourg, Lens 5-2 Auxerre, Le Mans 2-2 Brest, Nice 0-0 Lorient, Toulouse 0-2 Lyon, Troyes 0-0 Paris FC, Angers 0-2 Lille, Le Havre 0-1 Monaco, Rennes 2-2 PSG.

Elsewhere… Salah scores two for Trabzonspor

AZ Alkmaar are already the only team left in the Eredivisie with a perfect record, while newly promoted Maritimo briefly went top of the table in Portugal - check out this interview with their president on why being back matters so much to the island of Madeira here .

But the biggest story outside the biggest leagues came 5000 kilometres away across the other side of the continent as Mohamed Salah scored twice on his home league debut for Trabzonspor in a 2-1 win over Istanbul Basaksehir. There were glimpses of vintage Salah.

The first goal was scrappy but the second was sensational. Salah had said on arrival that he had never seen anything like his reception in Turkey before but what he did on the pitch was incredibly familiar. A clever give and go. The ball slotted low into the far corner.

He had two more goals disallowed for offside and was booked for a dive so it was certainly eventful. If Salah can produce more performances like this then the excitement surrounding a player some are calling the biggest star ever to go to Turkey will only grow.

articles.title: El Barça ha fichado un misil
articles.standfirst: Gordon exhibe en Elche su gran velocidad
articles.summary: Gordon exhibe en Elche su gran velocidad
articles.body: Una de las sorpresas del mercado del Barcelona se produjo a las primeras de cambio. En el mes de junio, el debate estaba en si el club ejecutaría la opción de compra de 30 millones que tenía sobre Marcus Rashford. Lo que en enero parecía claro, a final de temporada se había puesto muy crudo y todo hacía indicar que finalmente no se haría. Y así fue. Porque, incluso antes de que caducara el plazo de dicha opción, el Barcelona fichó a Anthony Gordon. Fue una sorpresa. Su nombre no se había barajado entre las opciones para reforzar el ataque, que se centraban más en un delantero centro. Fue una petición de Hansi Flick, que veía en el británico a un jugador con un enorme potencial. Lo había seguido a lo largo de la temporada y lo había visto en directo en los enfrentamientos de Champions con el Newcastle. Su principal virtud era la velocidad. Tiene el registro más alto de la Champions y ha alcanzado una velocidad punta de 37,92 km/h. En el pasado Mundial también fue el jugador más veloz. En el Barcelona no ha tardado en demostrarlo. Lo que hizo en Elche, en el cuarto gol, fue una clara exhibición. En apenas veinte metros sacó tres de ventaja a su rival para encarar al portero antes de regalarle el gol a Fermín. Fue una clara demostración de lo que tiene el Barcelona por la banda izquierda. Y Adeyemi no le va a la zaga por la derecha, porque también es un extremo muy veloz. Gordon, además, tiene otra gran virtud: la presión sobre el rival. Y, con esa velocidad, su capacidad para robar el balón es muy alta. La apuesta del Barcelona por Gordon ha sido muy potente. El inglés ha costado 70 millones de euros fijos, más otros 10 en variables. Hasta ahora, es el fichaje más caro, incluso por encima de Rodri. En su primer partido dio dos asistencias, un buen comienzo. Y no hay que olvidar que su polivalencia le permite jugar también como delantero centro.

articles.body: La UEFA celebra el sorteo de la fase de liga de la Champions League 2026/27, en el que los cinco representantes españoles conocerán a sus rivales en el nuevo formato europeo. El Real Madrid, el FC Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid parten desde el Bombo 1 junto a potencias continentales como el Bayern Múnich, el París Saint-Germain, el Liverpool, el Manchester City, el Inter de Milán y el Arsenal. Por su parte, el Real Betis arrancará su andadura desde el Bombo 2 al lado de clubes de la talla del Borussia Dortmund o el Manchester United, mientras que el Villarreal aguarda su turno encuadrado en el Bombo 3. La gala reunirá a las grandes figuras del fútbol europeo en el habitual escenario de Mónaco para definir los apasionantes cruces de esta primera fase de la máxima competición continental. El Sorteo de la Champions League 2026/27 se celebrará el próximo jueves 27 de agosto a partir de las 18:00 horas (horario peninsular español) en el Foro Grimaldi de Mónaco. El evento se podrá ver en directo por televisión en España a través del canal Movistar Liga de Campeones (dial 60 de la plataforma Movistar+), así como en directo online mediante los canales oficiales de la UEFA. articles.title: Julián Alvarez, sin salida
articles.standfirst: Mientras el Atlético no le dará ninguna opción de cumplir su sueño de jugar en el Barcelona, la vía del Arsenal también está lejana por la postura de las tres partes
articles.summary: Mientras el Atlético no le dará ninguna opción de cumplir su sueño de jugar en el Barcelona, la vía del Arsenal también está lejana por la postura de las tres partes
articles.body: Pese a los pitos con que el Metropolitano expresó su sentimiento a Julián Alvarez tras verbalizar (al finalizar la pasada temporada de manera privada y durante el Mundial públicamente) su deseo de ser traspasado este verano, lo cierto es que el argentino no tiene salida. Por un lado, porque el Atlético (con Miguel Ángel Gil a la cabeza, pero también a través de Enrique Cerezo o Mateu Alemany) ya le ha dejado claro que su sueño de jugar en el Barcelona no será posible salvo que desde el Camp Nou depositen los 500 millones de su cláusula. Por el otro, porque la vía del Arsenal, si bien se ha llegado a explorar, tampoco se vislumbra próxima por las reticencias de todas las partes. De ahí que, salvo giro inesperado e imprevisible en la última semana de mercado, a la Araña no le queda más remedio que revertir su situación como rojiblanco. Ya anunció Simeone durante su primera comparecencia de este curso en Seúl que tras la decisión tomada por el club de no acceder al traspaso le tendería la mano desde el plano deportivo para ayudarle a alcanzar su mejor versión. También los compañeros, con Oblak poniendo voz al vestuario, dejarían claro que el propósito de todos pasa por apoyar a Julián hasta el último día que vista como rojiblanco. E incluso el club trata de normalizar su día a día, como quedó probado cuando el pasado domingo le aconsejó no acercarse a saludar a la grada tras finalizar el partido para ahorrarle una última gran bronca. De ahí que sólo el 'perdón' que Griezmann se ganó sobre el campo en su día apunta como solución al enturbiado escenario en el que se mueve el argentino. Conocido por activa y por pasiva que el Barcelona no es una opción, Julián sabe que sólo el Arsenal podría llegar a ser una vía para no continuar de rojiblanco. Sin embargo, ni le seduce jugar en otro club que no sea el azulgrana ni al propio Atlético le satisfacen las condiciones que han planteado desde Londres a día de hoy. En este sentido, por más que la música de viento acompañe sus próximos días en el Metropolitano y su deseo de vestir de azulgrana no se pueda cumplir, su preferencia sigue siendo la de jugar en España, mostrándose muy reticente a regresar a la Premier tras su experiencia en el City y una vida en Inglaterra a la que tampoco ayudarían los problemas de visados para mantener a su familia cerca. Del mismo modo, aunque Arteta le recibiría con los brazos abiertos, los contactos entre Arsenal y Atlético tampoco han conseguido encontrar un punto de encuentro. Por un lado porque nunca se ha puesto sobre la mesa del Metropolitano una cifra superior a los 150 millones que sí estaba dispuesto a pagar el Real Madrid. Por el otro, porque la inclusión de Gyokeres en el traspaso nunca tuvo el visto bueno desde el Emirates Stadium. De ahí que el club rojiblanco se mantenga inamovible en su postura de seguir contando con Julián. Así las cosas, aunque las maniobras de Fernando Hidalgo para llevar a Julián al Camp Nou no han surtido efecto, aún resta una semana en la que su futuro seguirá generando ruido. No por la vía del Barcelona, sino porque precisamente ese asesoramiento tan censurado desde el Atlético no cierra la posibilidad de que su representante apriete para avivar la opción del Arsenal. No obstante, en los despachos del Metropolitano lo tienen claro: no hay salida.

articles.title: El Barcelona pone a cero el contador de un Camp Nou inexpugnable
articles.standfirst: El fortín construido como local la temporada pasada es una de las grandes bazas que les otorga Retabet para ganar LaLiga
articles.summary: El fortín construido como local la temporada pasada es una de las grandes bazas que les otorga Retabet para ganar LaLiga
articles.body: El Barcelona ha arrancado la defensa del título de Liga con una contundente victoria ante el Elche que invita a pensar que los de Hansi Flick no tienen intención de levantar el pie del acelerador. El objetivo vuelve a ser mayúsculo: enlazar un tercer campeonato consecutivo y consolidar un dominio que, por ahora, también tiene su reflejo en las apuestas deportivas. Para Retabet, el conjunto azulgrana parte como principal candidato para conquistar LaLiga con una cuota de 1.66 que le sitúa por delante del Real Madrid (2.12). El equipo de José Mourinho tuvo que sufrir para imponerse al Espanyol a domicilio con un gol de Carlos Espí sobre la bocina, mientras que el Barcelona dejó unas sensaciones inmejorables en su estreno y empieza a marcar territorio desde el primer día. Uno de los grandes argumentos con los que cuenta Flick esta temporada está en casa. A diferencia del curso pasado, cuando el Barcelona arrancó jugando en Montjuic y posteriormente tuvo que utilizar incluso el Johan Cruyff, esta vez podrá contar con el Camp Nou desde el inicio. Un factor que puede convertirse en diferencial en una carrera por el título en la que los pequeños detalles pueden acabar marcando la diferencia. No es casualidad que las mejores casas de apuestas sitúen al Barça por encima del resto. El precedente es difícil de mejorar. El Barcelona firmó la temporada pasada un pleno de victorias como local, algo que jamás había sucedido en LaLiga desde que la competición cuenta con 20 equipos. El fortín azulgrana fue inexpugnable... y ahora el gran reto consiste en prolongar esa dinámica. Retabet mantiene esa confianza y sitúa al conjunto catalán con una ventaja considerable respecto al Real Madrid en la pelea por el campeonato. La primera gran prueba llegará ante un Athletic Club que siempre exige el máximo y que será uno de los primeros equipos que intenten poner fin a esta racha. Sin embargo, para encontrar la última ocasión en la que los 'leones' lograron sacar algo positivo de su visita a la Ciudad Condal hay que remontarse hasta la temporada 2018-19. Desde entonces, el Barcelona ha conseguido convertir estos enfrentamientos en una auténtica fortaleza. Repetir el pleno de victorias de la pasada campaña parece una misión prácticamente imposible, pero ahora comienza otro desafío: descubrir quién será el primero capaz de poner fin a la resistencia del Camp Nou.

articles.title: El Barça condena la actuación policial en Elche con sus aficionados
articles.standfirst: Golpearon con porras a los aficionados, hubo un detenido y confiscaron banderas esteladas
articles.summary: Golpearon con porras a los aficionados, hubo un detenido y confiscaron banderas esteladas
articles.body: El Barcelona ha condenado a través de un comunicado la actuación policial de este domingo en Elche en el Martínez Valero cuando cargaron contra aficionados del Barcelona y les confiscaron banderas esteladas. En el enfrentamiento, sucedido antes del partido en las inmediaciones del estadio, las fuerzas de seguridad golpearon con porras a los aficionados para reducirlos. Este es el texto íntegro del comunicado: "El FC Barcelona condena el uso desproporcionado de la fuerza contra socios y aficionados del Club durante los hechos ocurridos ayer en los alrededores del estadio Martínez Valero, en la previa del partido de Liga disputado ante el Elche. En particular, el Club considera que el procedimiento de detención de uno de nuestros aficionados fue desproporcionado y careció de la necesaria congruencia y oportunidad en el uso de la fuerza. El FC Barcelona se pone a disposición del aficionado detenido y de su familia para ofrecerles el apoyo que puedan necesitar. Asimismo, el FC Barcelona lamenta que, una vez más, agentes de la Policía requisaran banderas esteladas a aficionados azulgranas. La estelada es un símbolo legal y su exhibición constituye una manifestación legítima de la libertad de expresión y no puede ser considerada, por sí misma, una incitación al odio o a la violencia. El FC Barcelona queda a la espera de las correspondientes explicaciones sobre los hechos y se reserva el derecho de emprender las actuaciones que considere oportunas para defender la integridad, los derechos y la libertad de expresión de sus socios y aficionados, tanto en el Spotify Camp Nou como en los estadios de los equipos rival".

articles.title: Flick ganó a Terzic la única vez que se enfrentaron ... y también fue de los que le animó a fichar por el Athletic
articles.standfirst: El recién estrenado técnico del Athletic visitó a su compatriota el pasado marzo en Barcelona
articles.summary: El recién estrenado técnico del Athletic visitó a su compatriota el pasado marzo en Barcelona
articles.body: El calendario de Liga ha reservado para este jueves en el Camp Nou el primero de los dos enfrentamientos previstos entre los dos técnicos alemanes que dirigen en el campeonato. El Barcelona-Athletic medirá a Flick (61 años) y Terzic (43). Los dos comparten experiencias y Terzic, recién estrenado técnico del Athletic, no oculta su admiración por el azulgrana. "Es un gran entrenador y también puedo decir que es un ser humano fantástico", comentó el rojiblanco en su presentación como relevo de Valverde en San Mamés. El duelo de este jueves será el segundo entre los dos, que en su carrera se vieron sólo una vez las caras al frente de los banquillos. Fue en marzo de 2021, en una temporada en la que Terzic se había hecho cargo del Borussia Dortmund como técnico interino y Flick entrenaba al Bayern Múnich. Ganaron los bávaros (4-2) con un hat trick de Lewandowski que sirvió para remontar un doblete de Haaland. El primer gol del partido lo había marcado el Bayern. La relación entre los dos entrenadores se fortaleció a partir de entonces porque cuando Terzic se hizo cargo después como técnico principal del Dortmund (2022-24) Flick dirigía a la selección de Alemania y su contacto era más que fluido. "Le conozco bien porque establecimos una buena relación. Llevaba a la selección a seis jugadores de mi anterior equipo ", explicó Terzic. Que Flick es una de las referencias de Terzic quedó claro cuando el pasado marzo el ahora entrenador del Athletic visitió al técnico del Barcelona en las instalaciones del club azulgrana. Y entre todo lo que hablaron también apareció el Athletic. "Hablé con Hansi porque quería saber qué es lo que cambió en su vida trabajando primero en la Bundesliga y luego en la Liga. Le visité para conocer un poco más cuál era su experiencia". Flick, igual que hizo Heynckes, le animaron a fichar por el Athletic. El preparador de Menden tiene ahora un gran reto por delante. Su Athletic viene de perder en el debut de Liga frente al Sevilla y se presenta ahora en un campo en el que no rasca nada desde hace 25 años. Curiosamente, el técnico que firmó aquel triunfo con goles de Urzaiz y Ezquerro fue Jupp Heynckes.

articles.title: Ranking the 10 Worst Kits in World Football for the 2026-27 Season
articles.summary: The new season is finally here. Club football is back mere minutes after the 2026 FIFA World Cup finished, bringing with it a new set of awful kits to digest.
articles.body:
The new season is finally here. Club football is back mere minutes after the 2026 FIFA World Cup finished, bringing with it a new set of awful kits to digest.

If you like bad colourways, questionable designs and big clubs just getting it wrong, this is for you.

The shirt is actually quite nice from far away, but get closer and the neon stripes start to look a lot more like claw marks. It has training-top energy, something bold enough to get people interested, but really should only be worn before matches.

The thing is, Spurs' purple third shirt would make quite a nice away kit. It's not great by any means, but it does seem more fitting than this Nike concoction, which looks weirder the longer you stare at it. What's that line above the sponsor?

To be fair to FC Basel, they might have the two worst kits combined this year.

The home shirt's red and blue are so bold, it's like when you accidentally set hue and saturation to extremes when editing kits on the old Pro Evolution Soccer games.

The away kit goes the other way, appearing as if it's lost all sense of personality after a heavy wash. Yellow and white are a very flushed-out colour combination. So much so, you can't even really see the club badge.

Do you remember those optical illusions that force you to stare at an unbearable pattern in the hope an image pops out? Norwich City's third shirt is like that, but what appears is just short of a headache.

The purple-and-mint design looks just like the seats on old English buses. The Canaries launched the shirt with photos on a bus, so it's probably what they were going for…

Maybe more kits need to lean into old niches like that. Next season could be based on the parachute game or hopscotch.

Live All the Action: Fulham vs. Chelsea 🔥

A good example of getting too creative for the sake of it.

Real Madrid's home shirt doesn't need green and red stripes; the latter are completely distracting. It's rare for Adidas to miss the mark for one of its big clubs, but this just isn't cutting it, as it doesn't come across as classic or particularly modern.

Instead, Los Blancos' new home kit looks like one your mate would pick up cheap in bulk ahead of your next five-a-side match against Dungdee United.

South African side Kaizer Chiefs have had some bangers over the years. They pretty much always try to do something different. That should be applauded.

This year's away kit silences those claps.

The spiky design is meant to mirror a lion's mane, but the way the sponsor sits on it is uneven. The top looks like a sports bra, and the bottom is so bare that it brings attention to the Charlie Brown vibe that dominates everything. Not good.

I have a theory that FC Luzern decided to put out an ugly away kit so their special anniversary shirt would look even better. The latter is beautiful—a classic design that could be worn away from the football pitch.

The away kit, though, is struggling under the pressure of that thick blue stripe with a smaller gold stripe inside.

There's interesting history behind the idea, which takes inspiration from the Jesuit church, but it's a heavy-handed design that isn't helped by the stripe and neckline combo looking like a Lego hand pointing upwards.

There's an air of Only Fools & Horses about the chevron design on a shirt that is doing way too much.

Maybe it'd look good with a flat cap, down the betting shop. Maybe multiple blues on multiple reds, with a stripe on the collar and sleeves, stamped with a less-than-elegant sponsor isn't going to create the nicest shirt in the world.

To stick with the old British comedy analogies…Bournemouth's home shirt is reminiscent of Kryten from Red Dwarf .

That middle circle, with the encased sponsor, looks like the perfect hole to slot in a hoover or whisk.

If you have no idea what I'm talking about, do yourself a favour and seek the show out. I promise it's funnier than this article.

Adidas' brief for Newcastle's new shirt must have been: "Take the classic black and white stripes and absolutely batter them." We've got wide, we've got narrow. There's so much going on when, similar to iconic strips like Ajax, it just needs to be toned down.

To make things worse, the Magpies' rivals will be wearing one of the nicest home shirts of the season. Sunderland went ultra classic with it, rather than working to destroy an easy seller each year by dressing the team up as human barcodes.

Austrian side TSV Hartberg collect sponsors like an old rocker collects stitched badges for their denim jacket.

Their kits are defined by commercial spew. All of the shirts are basic, aside from being packed with seemingly any company who will give the club money.

There can't be a world where fans will look at these and say, "Oh yeah, I'm spending money on that." But then, perhaps that's the point. The money could already be locked in, with the knowledge that any shirt featuring "Spermbooster" probably has its own special place in football history.

articles.title: 2026 College Football's Best Defensive Duos
articles.summary: Although the most successful teams rely on a deep group of contributors, elite talent will always headline a roster.
articles.body:
Although the most successful teams rely on a deep group of contributors, elite talent will always headline a roster.

In the 2026 college football season, any number of programs could identify a couple of standout defenders that deserve some national shine. Texas, for example, boasts edge-rusher Colin Simmons and linebacker Rasheem Biles.

This list, however, centers on players who share a position group.

While the players featured are subjective picks, past production and outlook for the upcoming season are main factors.

For good reason, most of the attention on Alabama is focused on the quarterback battle. Keelon Russell or Austin Mack will undoubtedly play a larger role in determining the Crimson Tide's upside in 2026.

Bray Hubbard, a two-year starter, notched 79 tackles and earned first-team All-SEC honors last season. Keon Sabb, meanwhile, has collected 93 stops with three interceptions since transferring from Michigan.

After both decided to put the NFL on hold, Hubbard and Sabb have a great opportunity to thrive in Tuscaloosa and be Day 1/2 picks in the 2027 draft.

Whenever the eligibility cases of Stephen Daley and Kellan Wyatt are decided, Indiana could be absolutely stacked on the edge.

For now, however, we know the Hoosiers are bringing back a tremendous duo at the second level. Rolijah Hardy and Isaiah Jones both garnered All-Big Ten recognition for the national champions last year.

Hardy led IU with 102 tackles, amassing 15 stops for loss and eight sacks. Jones posted 78 takedowns and basically matched Hardy at 15.5 TFLs and seven sacks.

Indiana's depth is a bit shaky, but this starting tandem could hardly be better.

Last season, the edge-rushing duo of Rueben Bain Jr. and Akheem Mesidor commanded the spotlight. This fall, the 'Canes should be electric on the inside.

Ahmad Moten Sr. is the more accomplished player at this stage. He jumped from being a promising piece in 2024 to a second-team All-ACC choice last year, recording 4.5 tackles for loss while serving as a reliable run-stuffer.

Justin Scott exploded in the second half of 2025 to bolster Miami's national runner-up finish. He racked up 22 tackles (6.5 TFLs) from November on.

Moten and Scott can create significant havoc from the interior—and both are projected first-round selections early in the NFL 2027 draft cycle.

Leonard Moore and Christian Gray, Notre Dame

The absurd part about this Notre Dame defense is you could make a compelling case for linebackers Drayk Bowen and Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa. I can entertain an argument for safeties Adon Shuler and Tae Johnson, too.

But there may not be a better pair of corners in the country, either.

Leonard Moore secured first-team AP All-America honors in 2025, snagging five interceptions and yielding a comically low 45.9 passer rating when targeted.

Christian Gray is best remembered for a clutch interception that set up ND's winning field goal against Penn State in the CFP semifinals two seasons ago. He also has gathered 20 pass breakups over the last two years and offers positional versatility as a traditional corner and nickelback.

Regardless of where Gray ultimately lines up, the Fighting Irish will be extremely confident in their coverage unit.

Returning to the second level, Oklahoma has a rock-solid set of linebackers with veterans Kip Lewis and Owen Heinecke.

Back in April, Heinecke received a preliminary injunction that granted him a sixth year of eligibility . The NCAA is appealing the decision, which may not be resolved before Week 1—or even during the season.

Unless a court rules otherwise, Heinecke will reunite with Kip Lewis in 2026. They finished first and second in tackles for OU last season, and each recorded at least 10.5 tackles for loss.

Oklahoma made the 2025 CFP on the strength of its defense, and a playmaking duo like Heinecke and Lewis may be critical to a repeat trip.

Matayo Uiagalelei and Teitum Tuioti, Oregon

Do you prefer A'Mauri Washington and Bear Alexander at defensive tackle or Matayo Uiagalelei and Teitum Tuioti on the edge?

The short version: Oregon is awfully spoiled up front.

Last season, Tuioti registered 68 tackles and paced the Ducks with 16 tackles for loss and 9.5 sacks. He was a third-team All-Big Ten selection.

Uiagalelei added 34 stops with 9.5 TFLs and six sacks, and he contributed 52 total pressures, per Pro Football Focus . That followed a 2024 campaign in which he notched 12.5 stops for loss and 10.5 sacks.

Between these nightmares on the edge and two standout D-tackles, Oregon will be a nightmare to block this fall.

Ben Roberts and Austin Romaine, Texas Tech

That's the expectation for Austin Romaine, a two-time second-team All-Big 12 linebacker at Kansas State. He amassed 162 tackles with 14 for loss, three forced fumbles and an interception over the last two years.

Romaine is set to debut at Texas Tech, which returns Ben Roberts—the Most Outstanding Player of the 2025 Big 12 Championship Game. While earning third-team All-Big 12 honors last season, Roberts put up 90 tackles, four interceptions and two forced fumbles.

As if that's not enough, Roberts had 107 tackles in 2023 and 83 in 2024. He combined to tally 11 stops for loss and five more forced fumbles in those seasons.

It's safe to say offensive coordinators aren't excited to see Romaine and Roberts now at the same program.

articles.title: Expert College Football Betting Locks for 2026 Win Total Bets
articles.summary: On paper, it all looks so easy.
articles.body:
The wins and losses seem so clear months in advance, before a single point is scored in the college football season. The reality, however, is that the unexpected will become the norm, and many of the assumptions made in August will prove wrong, one way or another.

Which brings us to the task of tackling this year's lineup of win totals. Perhaps no future bet is more direct than this one, the art of predicting whether a football team will overperform or underperform.

Some games are locks. Some are coin flips. Some, for most, are uphill climbs. Very little of it will go to plan, although a final number will be decided at the end.

With no shortage of teams to pick from, that's what we set out to do today. From the good to the (potentially) bad, here are some of the win totals we like heading into the season.

With so much change, there is much to discuss. But rather than start at the QB or the coach or the many new faces, we must start with the schedule.

In fact, let's take it a step further: Double woof.

Penn State does not play Ohio State, Indiana or Oregon. Road games at Michigan and Washington will be a challenge, and a home game against USC won't be easy. But Matt Campbell is primed to start his Happy Valley tenure with a bang.

As for the roster, it features a plethora of new faces. The most important is unquestionably quarterback Rocco Becht, who joined Campbell at Penn State along with his offensive coordinator.

Also joining them is tight end Benjamin Brahmer, who was a massive, critical weapon for Becht in Ames.

The defense should be solid immediately thanks to defensive coordinator D'Anton Lynn, who worked wonders at USC. He'll have to manage a defense filled with change, and he'll have capable players to work with.

Everything is aligned here for Penn State to win 10 games, even if that might seem a little too soon for some.

The good news for those who feel South Carolina is capable of a bounceback season is that things start favorably.

Kent State, Towson and Mississippi State are on the docket to start the year, although the game against the Bulldogs is no pushover. From there, perhaps outside of a road trip to Arkansas, the schedule is an absolute gauntlet.

Road trips include visits to Alabama, Florida, Oklahoma and Clemson. South Carolina will also play Tennessee, Texas A&M and Georgia.

Yes, there is talent on this roster. In fact, the high-end talent is exceptional. Dylan Stewart is an elite defensive player. Quarterback LaNorris Sellers and wideout Nyck Harbor have seemingly unlimited potential on offense.

Sellers, in particular, is critical. He must play better than he did last year, and he likely will be. But unless he takes that next step, it's hard to envision South Carolina navigating such a difficult path without anything beyond bowl eligibility.

No team underwent a more extensive makeover than Oklahoma State. Mike Gundy was fired, Eric Morris was hired and the roster was essentially remade from scratch.

The most interesting part, however, is what Morris brought with him to start. For all the new faces, none are more impactful than quarterback Drew Mestemaker and running back Caleb Hawkins.

Both give this team a shot. It's that simple.

Sure, the pieces have to come together in a short period of time, but such is life in college football in 2026.

For a team with so many new parts, the schedule (and conference) cooperates. A Week 2 game against Oregon likely won't go well. But beyond that, no individual game on the schedule feels unconquerable.

One of the few certainties in the Big 12 is that Texas Tech, even with questions at QB, appears to be the most talented team in the conference by a wide margin. Outside of that, the path is clear for a team like Oklahoma State to break through.

It's a lot to ask for a program that has changed so much. But the talent at key positions gives them a shot.

The roster is talented, the head coach is excellent, and the team is coming off a College Football Playoff showing. With that firmly acknowledged, the Aggies could struggle to deliver the kind of season they did one season ago.

On offense, the line had to be remade and KC Concepcion, the team's best wideout, is off to the NFL.

Marcel Reed certainly has plenty of skills, but his accuracy remains a work in progress. It was also evident in his team's final two games last season. Against Texas and Miami, the QB accounted for four interceptions and no scores.

Again, he can be great. But it's fair to assess just how much better he will be, especially with many new pieces around him.

The other reality A&M faces is the schedule. Last year, things broke well. The Aggies were 4-0 in the regular season in games decided by a touchdown or less, and they certainly needed plenty of unique moments to get there.

This year, things seem tougher on paper. It doesn't start terribly tough, although the final five games are as such: at Alabama, at South Carolina, vs. Tennessee, at Oklahoma and vs. Texas.

When you retrace how exactly Ole Miss came within a few plays of making the national championship, it still doesn't feel quite real.

The Rebels changed their starting QB, lost their coach and somehow kept it together amid chaos. Now, Pete Golding will have a shot at delivering an encore from start to finish.

In many respects, this is a bet on Trinidad Chambliss. He started the year as an unknown backup, and he emerged as one of the most exciting players in all of college football. Having running back Kewan Lacy back gives Ole Miss the most electric tandem in the country.

Sure, the schedule is brutal. Of course it is.

The Rebels start with Louisville, and that won't be a picnic. They're currently a less-than-a-touchdown favorite.

They'll play LSU a few weeks later at home, which promises to be one of the wildest environments of the year. Games at Florida, Texas and Oklahoma will also be challenging.

Like many in the SEC, the schedule will require plenty of things to go right and key players to stay healthy. But the quarterback is simply sensational, and that alone is worth betting on.

Sure, the offseason was turbulent. Quarterback Demond Williams Jr. was seemingly headed elsewhere, although he landed back with his team from a year ago. Washington has a cozy start to its season and a slew of winnable games along the way. Anything less than eight wins would surprise.

The Cougars were a tremendous surprise last year, and head coach Willie Fritz will have quarterback Conner Weigman back. Still, the offensive line needs major massaging and the schedule, in particular the road trips on tap, could make this a more difficult campaign to navigate.

There's not a game on the schedule that doesn't feel like it can't be won. A road trip to Vanderbilt and a home game against Louisville are the highlights on paper, and even those games can be conquered. The rest of the slate is supremely manageable, and quarterback CJ Bailey is poised for a breakout year.

Pat Fitzgerald is back, and we'll see how exactly he fits Michigan State long term. In the short term, he's coming into a difficult situation. Having to play Notre Dame in an out-of-conference game is not what any first-year head coach wants. And while some of the conference games feel like a coin flip, Sparty might not be ready for what's about to transpire.

articles.title: Falsa alarma: lo de Gavi se queda en un susto
articles.standfirst: El jugador tranquilizó a sus seguidores a través de las redes
articles.summary: El jugador tranquilizó a sus seguidores a través de las redes
articles.body: El Barcelona consiguió un excelente triunfo en Elche, pero se llevó un gran susto con Gavi, que tuvo que ser sustituido poco antes del descanso por una lesión. El Barcelona confirmó en un comunicado que no existía ninguna lesión grave: "Gavi recibió un golpe en la rodilla derecha durante el partido de ayer. Las pruebas médicas realizadas esta mañana han confirmado que se trata únicamente de una contusión. Su reincorporación a los entrenamientos está prevista en un plazo breve". El que también se ha manifestado ha sido el propio jugador a través de las redes sociales. No ha explicado qué es lo que tiene, pero su mensaje deja claro que no se trata de una lesión de gravedad, como en un principio se pudo temer. El centrocampista se pronunció con un mensaje en las redes. «Gracias a los que están siempre conmigo y apoyándome y van conmigo a muerte. No entiendo el fútbol de otra manera. Lo siento por haceros sufrir tanto», dijo el futbolista. La lesión se la produjo cuando hizo una entrada a un jugador rival que acabó con falta del azulgrana. El barcelonismo puede respirar tranquilo porque hubo mucho temor a que sufriera una nueva lesión grave, como las que ha tenido en los últimos años. Sobre todo, porque el golpe sufrido fue en la misma rodilla en la que tuvo problemas con anterioridad. Todo ha quedado en un susto y falta por ver si finalmente puede estar frente al Athletic.

articles.title: SC Cambuur fans suffer burns and eye injuries after Feyenoord supporters throw fireworks
articles.summary: Dutch side SC Cambuur says fans were left with "burns, hearing damage and eye injuries"  after Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks during Sunday's Eredivisie match.
articles.body:
Dutch club SC Cambuur said fans have suffered "burns, hearing damage and eye injuries" after Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks during Sunday's league match.

Play was suspended for around 10 minutes in the first half after visiting fans in the away end at the Kooi Stadion lit a large number of red flares and threw fireworks.

Some of the fireworks were aimed towards sections containing home fans and SC Cambuur said in a statement that five supporters were confirmed to have been injured.

Feyenoord said it "firmly distances itself from the unacceptable events" and that head coach Giovanni van Bronckhorst - an assistant to Arne Slot at Liverpool last season - apologised on behalf of the club to SC Cambuur after the match.

"It should be clear that setting off and firing fireworks is completely unacceptable and has no place in a football stadium whatsoever," SC Cambuur said.

The club, who were promoted to the Eredivisie last season after three seasons in the Dutch second tier, said it would work with the authorities to make sure those responsible were punished, while Feyenoord said they would request camera footage.

Last season, an Eredivisie match between Ajax and Groningen was abandoned after fireworks and flares were ignited behind one of the goals at Johan Cruyff Arena.

Feyenoord's general manager Robert Eenhoorn said he "cannot be happy" with their 5-2 victory in Leeuwarden, adding "frustration prevails too much for that".

"This problem obviously does not only affect Feyenoord and is unfortunately something we have been unable to put a stop to for decades," Eenhoorn said.

"We will therefore have to sit down again with all stakeholders, clubs, the KNVB [Dutch football association], and the authorities to look for a solution together."

Leeuwarden mayor Foort van Oosten also condemned the incident and promised an investigation, while the Dutch football association said it would revisit its protocols for incidents of disorder.

The game resumed despite the injuries to the fans, but it would have been abandoned had a player or match official been hit.

"That doesn't feel right," Jan Bluyssen, the KNVB's manager of professional football competition affairs, told Dutch news agency ANP.

"We need to examine whether the protocol is still appropriate and how we might want to adjust it."

images.caption: Image caption, One of the fireworks exploded just metres away from Feyenoord goalkeeper Tjark Ernst
Image caption, Play was suspended at the Kooi Stadion in the 12th minute

articles.title: Rodri y Balde, pendiente de su salida, se entrenan con los suplentes del Barça
articles.standfirst: El lateral fue baja en Elche por decisión técnica
articles.summary: El lateral fue baja en Elche por decisión técnica
articles.body: El Barcelona no tiene tiempo para el descanso. Tras golear anoche al Elche, se impuso por cinco goles a cero, este lunes por la mañana volvió al trabajo en la Ciudad Deportiva. Aunque, lógicamente, los futbolistas se ejercitaron con diferentes cargas en función de su desgaste en el día de ayer. El jueves vuelven a competir: será en el Spotify Camp Nou contra el Athletic.  En la sesión de esta jornada, los profesionales de Flick que disfrutaron de más minutos en el Martínez Valero realizaron ejercicios de recuperación, y sólo saltaron al césped  del campo Tito Vilanova Raphinha, Karim Adeyemi, Pedri y Fermín López. Los futbolistas que no jugaron o tuvieron una participación más testimonial hicieron un entrenamiento más activo. Entre estos jugadores destaca la presencia de Rodri, fichado la semana pasada, que completó el entrenamiento entero junto a sus compañeros. También estaba Alejandro Balde, baja en Elche por decisión técnica, Flick no le ve centrado ni aportando el cien por cien, y que se está buscando una salida del Barça. El resto de jugadores que trabajaron de forma intensa fueron Olmo, Brian Fariñas, Cortés, Gordon, Bisiwu, Koundé, Cancelo, Cubarsí, Szczesny, Eder Aller y Hamza Abdelkarim. Quien, lógicamente, no se entrenó fue Gavi, que concluyó el encuentro con molestias en la rodilla y se sometió a pruebas que descartaron una dolencia grave en la articulación. Sólo sufre una contusión. El Barça volverá a ejercitarse mañana martes por la mañana. Los jugadores de Flick se miden el jueves, en el primer partido liguero en el Spotify Camp Nou, a las 21.30 horas, al Athletic.

articles.title: Cucurella: "Ya está aquí el momento de vestir la camiseta del mejor club del mundo"
articles.standfirst: Acto de bienvenida para el campeón del mundo
articles.summary: Acto de bienvenida para el campeón del mundo
articles.body: A dos días después de conocer cómo es el Bernabéu como jugador local, Marc Cucurella vivió su acto de presentación. El campeón del mundo con España y también con el Chelsea escenificó su llegada a la Casa Blanca junto al presidente de la entidad, Florentino Pérez. Después de que el Madrid impactara con su fichaje a mediados de junio, dos meses después se formaliza la presencia de Cucurella con el acto que se ha ido sucediendo a lo largo de los últimos días. Cucurella fue una operación relámpago en la que Jose Mourinho fue clave. El entrenador del Real Madrid fijó su nombre como prioridad absoluta para potenciar un lateral izquierdo en el que el catalán no fue titular el pasado sábado en Cornellà, pero sí que tuvo minutos de cara a una titularidad que es indiscutible. El miércoles, ante la Real, Sociedad Cucurella volverá a pisar el verde del Bernabéu. No lo hace desde marzo de 2024. Un momento que le cambió la vida. Con la selección española, ante Brasil, fue titular después de ser convocado por la baja de Gayá. Desde ese día, es el lateral zurdo indiscutible de Luis de la Fuente. Un camino que le llevó a fichar por el Madrid. Al sumarse a los entrenamientos de su nuevo equipo, Cucurella explicó las sensaciones que le provocaba la nueva etapa de su vida: "Estoy muy feliz. Detrás de todo esto hay mucho trabajo y todo el esfuerzo que he puesto estos años ha valido la pena. Estoy muy feliz por todo lo que me está pasando y ojalá siga así, ganando títulos y, sobre todo, poder disfrutar de esta experiencia". Y agradecía el apoyo de una afición ante la que se presentará en pocas horas: "He recibido muchos mensajes e intentaré dar lo mejor de mí siempre y en todos los minutos que tenga. Creo que lo más importante y lo que todos queremos es ganar títulos con esta camiseta”. El acto repitió el guion de los anteriores: el Florentino Pérez le recibió en la sala de juntas, donde el defensa firmó el contrato que le unirá al club las seis próximas temporadas, hasta el 30 de junio de 2032. Después de la firma, Cucurella recibió una réplica del estadio, un reloj y una camiseta con su nombre y el dorsal número 17. Al acto también asistió el presidente de honor, José Martínez, Pirri. Después, aparecieron palabras suyas en la web del club: "El verano se ha hecho largo. Pero ya está aquí el momento de vestir la camiseta del mejor club del mundo, que tantos títúlos ha ganado y le queda por ganar. Es un orgullo, un honor". Como el resto de los fichajes, el fondo eran las 15 Champions. "La verdad es que impresiona. Me acuerdo mucho de la ganada con las remontadas. Ojalá pueda ganar alguna. Al Bernabéu lo he sufrido como visitante. Es un campo mágico en el que pueden pasar cosas increíbles en diez minutos. Tengo muchas ganas de jugar ahí", explicó Cucurella.

articles.title: Columbia HSFB Team Snaps 101-Game Losing Streak, Longest in History, Led by Former NFL WR as HC
articles.summary: A losing streak that stretched to 101 games is finally over for Columbia High School in Huntsville, Alabama.
articles.body:
A losing streak that stretched to 101 games is finally over for Columbia High School in Huntsville, Alabama.

Columbia beat Greensboro High School 41-14 on Saturday.

"All the glory to God," Columbia coach Sammie Coates said, per AL.com's Thomas Ashworth . "God has blessed me to be in this situation to bring this to this school, to this community. I want to say thank you to the administration, to the school supporting me, having my back the whole time, and the players showing up and fighting every single day throughout the spring, throughout the summer, everything they have done.

"They deserve every moment of this. They stuck it out. Guys came out and helped support. We built the program, and it's coming. We ain't there yet, but we are coming."

Coates, who starred at Auburn as a wide receiver before playing four years in the NFL, is in his second season at the helm. According to Kaleigh Tingelstad and Mike Brown of 48 News in Huntsville, he had just 28 players on the roster by the time the 2025 campaign concluded.

Now, Columbia is 1-0 to kick off 2026, and the Eagles prevailed in emphatic fashion. They reeled off 41 unanswered points after going behind 14-0.

Running back Christian Richey was a standout performer, eclipsing 200 yards from scrimmage and scoring four touchdowns.

Having a coach with an NFL pedigree certainly helped to build Columbia's profile, and the school began working with Gatorade in August 2025 to give its players an added boost.

articles.title: Bruno Iglesias encuentra en Ucrania el impulso que buscaba
articles.standfirst: El exjugador del Real Madrid anotó su primer gol con el conjunto ucraniano, que lidera la liga junto al Shakhtar
articles.summary: El exjugador del Real Madrid anotó su primer gol con el conjunto ucraniano, que lidera la liga junto al Shakhtar
articles.body: Bruno Iglesias empieza a encontrar en Ucrania el impulso que buscaba. El salmantino, que este verano puso fin a doce años de formación en el Real Madrid, ya ha estrenado su cuenta goleadora con el Karpaty Lviv y lo hace en un equipo que ha comenzado la temporada lanzado: tres victorias en tres jornadas y liderato compartido con el Shakhtar. El centrocampista de 23 años llegó a Lviv con un contrato de 2+1 y con una figura clave detrás de su desembarco: Fran Fernández. El técnico español fue quien apostó por él y le convenció para dar el salto a Ucrania. Una aventura que, en el caso del entrenador, también generó dudas en su entorno. Cuando decidió marcharse a un país en guerra, algunos le decían directamente: “Me decían que si estaba loco”. Ahora, meses después, Fernández lidera un Karpaty que ha arrancado con pleno de victorias y que tiene entre sus objetivos regresar a Europa. Y Bruno empieza a tener protagonismo en ese proyecto. El exmadridista ya había debutado en Liga ante el Bukovyna y acaba de dar un paso más con su primer gol con la camiseta verdiblanca. En Ucrania se ha encontrado, además, con un cuerpo técnico español y varios compatriotas, algo que ha facilitado su adaptación. "Creo que puedo ser útil en todas estas áreas en el último tercio del campo. Puedo ayudar al equipo a crear ocasiones, dar pases, disparar y, por supuesto, marcar. Para mí, lo principal es ser útil al equipo y hacer lo que nos ayude a ganar", explicó el jugador a un medio local. Lviv también le ha convencido. En una entrevista con medios ucranianos, Bruno aseguró que no necesitó mucho tiempo para decidirse cuando apareció la oportunidad: “Es una oportunidad muy grande”. También destacó la acogida de sus compañeros, la belleza de la ciudad y hasta empieza a familiarizarse con el idioma y la gastronomía local. El Karpaty ha encontrado así una pieza que conoce bien Fran Fernández y Bruno, un escenario nuevo en el que volver a sentirse protagonista después de cerrar su larga etapa en el Real Madrid. El chico que llegó a Valdebebas desde la UD Santa Marta, que fue capitán del Madrid en la Youth League y que terminó jugando en el Castilla, empieza a escribir ahora otro capítulo de su carrera, esta vez a miles de kilómetros de casa. Y, de momento, el comienzo no puede ser mejor: gol, victorias y liderato.

articles.title: Cuatro partidos de la Primera división femenina entrarán en La Quiniela
articles.standfirst: Es la culminación de una reivindicación impulsada por la Asociación de Futbolistas Españoles desde 2019
articles.summary: Es la culminación de una reivindicación impulsada por la Asociación de Futbolistas Españoles desde 2019
articles.body: La presencia de la Primera División femenina (Liga F) en el boleto de La Quiniela ya es una realidad. Cuatro partidos de la máxima categoría del fútbol femenino forman parte del boleto de esta semana, un paso de especial relevancia para la consolidación, visibilidad y reconocimiento de la competición dentro del deporte español. Este avance representa la culminación de una reivindicación impulsada por la Asociación de Futbolistas Españoles (AFE) desde 2019, cuando el sindicato puso en marcha la campaña #QuinielasEnFemenino. Desde entonces, AFE ha mantenido una línea de trabajo constante con instituciones y representantes políticos para defender la incorporación del fútbol femenino a La Quiniela como una herramienta para avanzar en igualdad y dotar a la Liga F de una mayor presencia social y deportiva. La inclusión encuentros de la Liga F en cada boleto supone, por tanto, mucho más que una novedad en La Quiniela. Constituye un reconocimiento al crecimiento experimentado por el fútbol femenino y una oportunidad para ampliar su alcance, acercarlo a nuevos públicos y reforzar su posición dentro del conjunto del fútbol profesional. Para AFE, este paso confirma que las reivindicaciones sostenidas en el tiempo, cuando se sustentan en el diálogo institucional y en una defensa firme de los derechos e intereses de las futbolistas, pueden traducirse en avances concretos. La presencia de la Liga F en La Quiniela contribuye a avanzar hacia un modelo más igualitario y con mayores oportunidades para el desarrollo y la proyección del fútbol femenino. La organización sindical valora especialmente que una reivindicación iniciada hace siete años sea hoy una realidad y considera esta incorporación un punto de partida para seguir avanzando. AFE continuará trabajando junto a las instituciones y los distintos agentes del fútbol para impulsar nuevas medidas que favorezcan la igualdad, mejoren las condiciones profesionales de las futbolistas y contribuyan a la dignificación y crecimiento del fútbol femenino en España.

articles.title: James Morrison: West Bromwich Albion boss backs Aune Heggebo following deception ban
articles.summary: West Bromwich Albion head coach James Morrison says the FA have "opened a can of worms" over Aune Heggebo's two-match ban for deception.
articles.body:
West Bromwich Albion head coach James Morrison says the Football Association have "opened a can of worms" over Aune Heggebo's two-match ban for deception.

Jimmy-Jay Morgan's cross hit Heggebo's hand on its way into the net to give Albion the lead in their 2-1 win over Norwich City on the first day of the Championship season.

The Norway international forward last week became the first player to be charged with "deception of a match official" since the rule was introduced in the 2017-18 season.

Morrison said the incident was accidental and that the onus had not been on the player to tell referee Tim Robinson.

"We wanted to back Bo because he's not that type of person," he told BBC Radio WM.

"He was upset because he was saying it [the charge] was calling him a cheat, basically, and we all know he's not that.

"He'll be looking at the cross when it came in, it flicked from the goalkeeper's hands into him.

"He's not going to run to the referee is he, and say, 'I handballed that'? Not in a million years."

The "disappointed" Albion boss said the ban had opened "a can of worms for the FA" to punish what they deem as deception.

Heggebo, 25, missed Sunday's 3-1 win over Burnley in the Championship and will also miss the Carabao Cup tie away to Newcastle United on Wednesday (19:45 BST).

"If they're going to do it, we accept it, but they've got to be consistent throughout the season," Morrison added.

"Be consistent throughout the season and we can all deal with that."

articles.title: 5-Star True Freshman Faizon Brandon Named Tennessee's QB1, What to Know About Top-10 Overall Recruit
articles.summary: Tennessee coach Josh Heupel is naming true freshman Faizon Brandon his starting quarterback for the 2026 season, according to ESPN's Pete Thamel.
articles.body:
Tennessee coach Josh Heupel is naming true freshman Faizon Brandon his starting quarterback for the 2026 season, according to ESPN's Pete Thamel .

Brandon was the No. 3 quarterback in 247Sports' composite rankings for the 2026 recruiting class. He beat out George MacIntyre to earn the QB1 role the Volunteers' opener against Furman on Sept. 5.

At Grimsley High School in Greensboro, North Carolina, Brandon threw for 6,374 yards and 79 touchdowns and ran for another 1,261 yards and 21 TDs.

247Sports' Andrew Ivins scouted him last December and drew a comparison to two-time NFL Pro Bowler Geno Smith. He called Brandon an "athletic quarterback with the arm and football character to eventually be a catalyst for multiple College Football Playoff runs."

Coming out of Tennessee's second scrimmage over the weekend, Heupel liked what he saw from both Brandon and MacIntyre on the deeper throws that are an important facet of the aerial attack.

"I feel like over the course of the two scrimmages, it's been really positive," the coach told reporters . "During the course of practice, it's been extremely positive. Today we were able to hit a couple of them. All parts of it have got to be tied together, too. The route, the coverage, and then the protection piece of it, too."

Across the board, the transfer portal has given coaches an incentive to play true freshmen earlier than they would've in the past. A blue-chip recruit who isn't happy with his playing time could be out the door in a year.

In this case, MacIntyre didn't have much of an experience edge on Brandon, either. He attempted nine total passes in 2025 while sitting behind Joey Aguilar and Jake Merklinger in the depth chart.

The schedule works out nicely as Brandon can get his feet wet against Furman before a tougher test against Georgia Tech in Atlanta awaits on Sept. 12. If everything goes according to plan, he'll have three starts under his belt before the Vols open SEC play against No. 5 Texas on Sept. 26.

articles.title: Raphinha y Fermín toman la delantera
articles.standfirst: El brasileño y el español fueron los '9' elegidos por Flick para el estreno liguero de un Barça que, sin embargo, sigue peinando el mercado en busca de un ariete
articles.summary: El brasileño y el español fueron los '9' elegidos por Flick para el estreno liguero de un Barça que, sin embargo, sigue peinando el mercado en busca de un ariete
articles.body: El estreno arrollador del Barcelona en Elche sirvió, además de para ver la enorme pegada azulgrana, para empezar a despejar toda una serie de dudas. La principal, la de la delantera. Raphinha es, a día de hoy, la primera opción para ocupar ese puesto a falta de que venga, o no, un ariete. Era el debut del vigente campeón liguero y había cierta expectación por ver quién haría de '9'. Pero tampoco hubo sorpresas. Flick apostó por Raphinha, con Adeyemi por la izquierda y Lamine, por la derecha. No era la primera vez que veíamos al ahora primer capitán en esa demarcación. Y parece que al técnico alemán le gusta cada vez más. "Tiene una gran mentalidad. Cuando ves que da el cien por cien en los entrenamientos es fantástico. Es un buen ejemplo, tiene gran intensidad", comentaba Flick tras la goleada al Elche. El propio Raphinha tampoco ocultaba lo cómodo que se encuentra en esa posición: "Tenemos capacidad para jugar en cualquier posición. Me encuentro cómodo estando en el campo". Su bagaje en el estreno liguero: dos goles y asistencia. Un buen doblete para empezar con buen pie LaLiga. Misma cifra que Fermín López, el otro aspirante al puesto. El canterano azulgrana, que salió de inicio, pero de mediapunta, demostró que su hambre de gol sigue más que intacta. Dos goles, uno de ellos de delantero puro: asistencia por el interior de Xavi Espart, control de Fermín, que se gira sobre sí mismo y dispara cruzado con la zurda. Gol de 'killer'. El de El Campillo demostró que puede jugar perfectamente de '9'. De hecho, hace apenas una semana ya dejó claro que puede y querría jugar ahí: "Me puedo adaptar. Ya jugué de falso 9 en categorías inferiores del Barça. Es una posición parecida a mi favorita". Calidad, rapidez, agilidad y hambre de gol no le faltan. Pero el Barça, aún habiendo empezando con una 'manita', sabe que debe completar la plantilla con un 'nueve' nato. La temporada es larga, muchos partidos, y en los duelos importantes de Champions jugar con falso nueve puede no ser suficiente. Flick es consciente de ello y por eso ayer volvió a recordar que el mercado no está cerrado: "Hablaremos después de este partido sobre el nueve. Hablo con Deco, estamos muy contentos por la victoria, pero veremos durante la semana". Mismo discurso que tienen los propios Raphinha y Fermín, que bien tan bien jugar de 'nueve' como que venga un jugador nuevo a esa posición. Así es el Barça de hoy, todos a una. "Nosotros confiamos en Deco y lo que decidan será lo mejor", decía el canterano, mismo discurso que el brasileño: "Eso lo dejamos al presi, a Deco y al míster". Si llega o no es algo que está por ver, pero lo que está claro es que gol a este equipo no le va a faltar mientras haya jugadores insaciables como los autores de sendos dobletes.

articles.title: Derek McInnes: Rangers manager could be in stand for first Old Firm game after hearing date set
articles.summary: Derek McInnes could be in the stand for his first Old Firm match as Rangers manager after a hearing date of 31 August was set for his appeal against a touchline ban.
articles.body:
Derek McInnes could be in the stand for his first Old Firm match as Rangers manager after a hearing date of 31 August was set for his appeal against a four-match touchline ban, one game of which is suspended.

The penalty issued in July related to McInnes' spell as Hearts boss last season, when he described the decision to award Celtic a late penalty at Motherwell in May as "disgusting".

A stoppage-time spot-kick for handball was converted by Kelechi Iheanacho and Celtic's 3-2 victory at Fir Park on 13 May kept them one point behind Hearts, who they beat to the title a few days later in a final-day decider.

Rangers argued the remarks were "directed at the decision, rather than representing any broader criticism of officials" when announcing their intention to contest the ban.

And McInnes, who could be in the stand for games against Falkirk, Motherwell and Celtic, added: "I don't agree with it and the club don't agree with it. I'm glad that we're going to appeal against that.

"I've been a manager for 19 years and you know you're going to be asked about contentious decisions and all the rest of it.

"I've never wanted to make it personal. For me, the decision was wrong. I feel as though I made my points at the hearing.

"Broadcasters pay a lot of money to hear managers' reactions. We've got to be careful that we don't have managers and players who have to be really sure of themselves and check themselves before answering a question.

"At no point was I wanting to inflame a situation. The situation was already being discussed before I did my Press. It was quite a big moment in the season and there was a lot of emotion, but I felt as though what I said was controlled."

The games against Falkirk away on 2 September and Motherwell three days later at home immediately after the hearing are in the Scottish Premiership, while the 13 September visit of Celtic is in the quarter-finals of the League Cup.

Girona winger Kim to undergo Rangers medical Published 1 day ago

Girona winger Kim to undergo Rangers medical

Visit our Rangers page for all the latest news, analysis and fan views

Speaking to Sky Sports after a win against Falkirk at Tynecastle on the same night as Celtic's win at Fir Park, McInnes said: "When you heard Celtic got a 96th-minute penalty that was going to VAR and they were checking it, you just assume what's happened is they get the penalty.

"Having seen it again, it's disgusting. It is. I don't think it's a penalty kick.

"But we're up against it. We're up against everybody."

Scottish FA head of referees Willie Collum later backed the call, citing "clear evidence" of Motherwell's Sam Nicholson's hand and arm "in an unnatural position" - and the resulting contact "a punishable handball".

Referee John Beaton's contact details were posted online, with police keeping his home under surveillance. A teenager was then charged "in connection with a data protection offence".

The statement from Rangers added: "Respect for officials and legitimate scrutiny are not competing principles.

"Managers, players and clubs must be able to speak honestly about major decisions if Scottish football is serious about raising standards and maintaining trust.

"Scrutiny, transparency and accountability should be seen as part of improving standards, not as a threat to them."

articles.title: Harvey Elliott: Does Liverpool midfielder have an Anfield future after Newcastle omission?
articles.summary: Harvey Elliott's position at Liverpool looks uncertain following his absence from the matchday squad at Newcastle on the opening weekend of the Premier League season.
articles.body:
It was a little under a month ago when in the bowels of the Yankee Stadium in New York, Harvey Elliott spoke candidly about his emotions after a "tough" loan spell at Aston Villa and why this summer felt like a second chance for Liverpool .

There was a smile on his face when he spoke about his love for the club - the team he has supported since he was a boy - and wanting to be free and enjoying himself again with his football, because he felt like he had not done that enough.

You only had to see Elliott's joy when he came off the bench in Liverpool 's friendly against Monaco earlier this month as all four sides of Anfield stood up and applauded to see what it meant.

With a number of senior first-team players absent, Elliott started Liverpool 's first friendly under Andoni Iraola in Nashville and again when Liverpool took on Wrexham in New York four days later but as the World Cup contingent returned, the midfielder was benched and where he stood in the squad became clearer.

On the first weekend of the Premier League season, Elliott was left out of the Liverpool squad entirely for their trip to Newcastle and it now looks increasingly likely that the 23-year-old could be on his way out before the transfer window ends.

Liverpool have received no offers for Elliott - who spent last season on loan at Aston Villa - and his exclusion from the squad on Sunday was not transfer related, nor is the midfielder carrying an injury.

Elliott's contract expires next summer and if first-team football is not possible at Liverpool he needs to go somewhere where it is, to avoid another lost season.

In America, Elliott spoke about how we would speak to Iraola at the "right time" and emphasised the need to be "selfish".

"Ultimately, I'm still wanting to be selfish, doing what's right for me," said Elliott. "Whether that's staying here and fighting for my place or potentially going elsewhere, I'm still unsure at the moment until I get some more intel."

Another year on the fringes would be no good for the man who was named player of the tournament when England Under-21s won the European Championship in 2025.

By now, much has been said about his situation at Villa last season which Unai Emery described as "embarrassing" for all involved.

Elliott played only nine games and a total of 277 minutes after Villa decided early on in the campaign that they did not want to trigger an obligation to sign him from Liverpool for Â£35m if he made 10 appearances.

Those at Villa stressed Elliott's professionalism and his positivity throughout and to his credit, the attacking midfielder returned early to Liverpool for the start of pre-season after a personally-challenging year.

Iraola himself was impressed by his attitude, saying as much in his introductory press conference.

"I've seen him with this eagerness to show himself. He will have a chance during the pre-season. He came one week earlier and I hope we can see him in a good place," said Iraola.

"Last season had to have been very difficult for him as it was a strange situation that meant they [ Aston Villa ] couldn't let him play."

In effect, the move to Villa wasted a season of Elliott's career even if he was adamant that it was a "learning curve" in a year where Villa won the Europa League.

"I don't wish it upon any other player, because it's not nice at all," Elliott said.

When he left Liverpool last summer, the primary factor was more game-time after making just one Premier League start during Liverpool 's title-winning campaign under Arne Slot in 2024-25.

So with a week to go of the transfer window and with further attacking signings expected at Anfield, perhaps the writing is on the wall.

A move lower down the Premier League or somewhere in Europe may be an option.

After all, this is a player who scored the winner for Liverpool at PSG in a year where the Ligue 1 club won the Champions League.

He is neat on the ball and unafraid to take risks - a return of 15 goals and 21 assists for Liverpool , across all competitions, showcases what he can do.

Either way, it is imperative for all involved that Elliott finds somewhere to play football regularly this season because it seems unlikely at Liverpool and at 23, he cannot afford to have a season like last.

articles.summary: El club perico tiene ya cerrado al extremo andaluz para reforzar la plantilla
articles.body: El Espanyol ya tiene al extremo que tanto deseaba. Se trata de Bryan Zaragoza, que llegará al equipo perico procedente del Bayern. Ambas entidades han llegado hoy a un acuerdo definitivo. Monchi ha completado su primera gran operación al frente de la dirección deportiva del Espanyol. Desde hace semanas, el responsable de la parcela deportiva pedía calma y señalaba que quería esperar para traer a un extremo de nivel. Finalmente, lo ha conseguido. Un futbolista desequilibrante, talentoso y con mucha chispa que fue internacional con España no hace mucho. A sus 24 años, el futbolista gozará de una gran oportunidad para ello, ya que además el Espanyol deberá comprarlo a final de temporada. Como ha anunciado Fabrizio Romano, las cifras de la operación son las siguientes: el Espanyol deberá desembolsar ocho millones de euros a final de curso para hacerse con el futbolista en propiedad. Bryan Zaragoza ha estado entrenando al margen en las instalaciones del club alemán para tratar de no perder la forma. El Espanyol dispondrá de un nuevo efectivo de gran nivel para su ataque.

articles.summary: El guardameta titular del Rayo se lesionó ante el Alavés y estará de baja un tiempo estimado de entre tres y seis meses
articles.body: Augusto Batalla, portero argentino del Rayo Vallecano, fue operado este lunes con éxito de una fractura de tibia en la pierna derecha en el Hospital FREMAP de Majadahonda (Madrid) por la doctora Fernández Hortigüela y el doctor González Rilo, según informó el club franjirrojo.
